market_context: The Nasdaq-100 rose 2.28% to 28,374.25 (QQQ +2.31% to $690.38) as chip and AI-infrastructure stocks rebounded after CoreWeave raised its 2026 outlook and said AI demand still outpaces capacity; the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumped 5.66%.
market_cap_basis: Shares outstanding x 2026-11-11 close. Shares implied from Nasdaq market caps as of the 2026-10-29 close (watchlist market_cap_usd / 2026-10-29 close), so multi-class companies (e.g. GOOGL) reflect all share classes.

stocks.name: Sandisk Corporation Common Stock
stocks.reason: Sandisk led a memory-and-storage rally after CoreWeave reported a beat-and-raise quarter, lifting names tied to AI data-center demand; Evercore ISI also reiterated its Outperform rating and $2,500 price target after meetings with CEO David Goeckeler, arguing investors are underestimating structural changes in its NAND business.
